historicalMigration: R7C B1C receipt confirms a real migration and same-transaction ledger; R5B source uses transaction advisory lock. These remain historical observations.
sessionLockAnalysis: Official session affinity supports session-level state; the actual runner uses a narrower transaction-scoped lock. Owned tests alone are not remote proof.
singleTransaction: DDL and ledger remain in the same persistent connection/transaction. No fallback, batch, retry or changes proposed.
backupOperationalHistory: R5C records a sealed R4D backup; R4D source exports a snapshot and imports it in pg_dump; R7C records logical restore verification. No current backup archive was opened.
snapshotRequirements: One exporter RR READ ONLY transaction must remain open until all importers start/use its snapshot.
Exporter and dump sessions must address the same project database/primary instance.
Session affinity retains each client connection; it does not establish fresh global capacity or prove every client TLS connection.
Current sequential dump pipeline needs at least exporter plus one tool connection concurrently; services and other operators need separate headroom.
pg_dumpall roles output is not covered by the exported user-database MVCC snapshot; retain before/after role metadata checks.

perToolProofPolicy.psql: Actual same-session libpq metadata plus pinned verify-full, CA, endpoint and tool identity.
perToolProofPolicy.pgDumpAndPgDumpall: Each invocation must independently bind pinned tool/libpq, immutable effective verify-full configuration/CA/target and exit success. This is enforced-connection attestation, not observed cipher metadata. A psql diagnostic must not be reused as proof of a dump connection.
perToolProofPolicy.remaining: Operator must approve whether enforcement attestation is sufficient or require a separately scoped actual per-tool TLS observation mechanism. No new code now.

directSuitability: Official maintenance pattern PROVEN; current project endpoint, credentials and capacity NOT_PROVEN. Direct removes pooler affinity/budget layer, not exported-snapshot lifetime requirements.
